method: Broad product-area searches across community.fortinet.com using technical-tip/troubleshooting-tip/KB terms and October 2026 date filters; only directly matched recent scenarios are linked to lessons. Unrelated recent findings are retained as sweep evidence but are not promoted to lesson scenarios.
